strategies.text:
Overview

Zamazenta Hero, originally a 6 star difficulty raid has been brought down to 4 star territory range due to the introduction of Future Sight+ skyrocketting Mega Mewtwo Y in the meta. This strategy revolves primarily recycling Mega Mewtwo Y and using TPC with various movesets incurring small adaptations.


Recall, tick perfect cast or TPC is the strategy of casting 1-bar charge moves the moment they are available without over buffering a fast move prior. This means mentally slowing down your taps as the energy nears 100 and precisely tap the charge move button upon reaching 100 energy.

Est Time to Win: 275.0s - 295.0s


Main Strategy

Any + Close Combat/Moonblast (4-5 rejoins)

The easiest moveset is vs Close Combat. Mega Mewtwo Y can tank up to 3 close combats while ideally dodging the rest until it is unable to meaningfully cast another Future Sight+. It's suggested to only dodge close combats where energy gained would overflow. Close combat grants roughly 22 energy, so this translates to dodging around 60-70% of the energy orb as the psycho cuts would cause an overflow.

In the same spirit Mega Mewtwo Y is able to absorb two Moonblasts before preferring to dodge. Shadow Salamence can alternatively be used to catch Moonblast and return damage with 2 Fly casts.

Any + Iron Head (5-6 rejoins)

Iron Head is a very aggressive high rejoin angle. To simplify, it is preferred to simply tank iron heads with the grace of being able to dodge 1 or 2. If Zamazenta-Hero learns snarl, this is likely a 6 rejoin territory solo.


Any + Crunch (5-6 rejoins)

Crunch is the hardest angle due to high aggressiveness and super effective damage. It is recommended to back up Mega Mewtwo Y with a Shadow Mewtwo and play for 5-6 rejoins. Shadow Mewtwo is able to tank 1 crunch, (sometimes 2 if the fast move is not snarl) and is ideally able to pump out 2-3 psystrikes. Sometimes 4. The Shadow Mewtwo is not there to increase DPS but rather lower rejoin count from the originally 8 -> 5-6. Therefore it's worth juicing Mega Mewtwo Y until 5-10% health and Shadow Mewtwo to ~50% health (unless a crunch is coming and it is able to absorb it).


Psystrike is used to execute the boss at low health if future sight+ cannot be built up in time.
